verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP is an integration and MCP platform, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no documentation of registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks that a programmatic consumer can receive. The only related item is a passing count of '4 triggers' for one app, which does not describe a way to register a webhook subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
